description: Multiplies the values in the field (column) of records in the database that match the conditions you specify.

params.description: The range of cells that makes up the list or database. A database is a list of related data.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The column which is used in the function. Either the label of the column in double quotation marks or a number that represents the column's position in the list.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The range of cells that contains the conditions you specify. The range includes at least one column label and at least one cell below the column label for a condition.
params.name: arg3

signature: DPRODUCT(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number | string, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName): number
